history.summary: A compact 839 sqft "3BR" freehold in D05 Pasir Panjang/West Coast (WhiteHaven, TOP 2017) at $1.5M / $1,788 PSF. Asking PSF is slightly below the $1,798 median, but a reliable 27-transaction URA base shows weak 1.02%/yr appreciation — the development has barely moved.
history.rating_rationale: WhiteHaven is fairly priced versus its block (asking $1,788 PSF just under the $1,798 URA median) and the $1.5M quantum is accessible and liquid. But the standout fact is the soft 1.02%/yr appreciation on a solid 27-transaction base — this freehold has materially lagged the RCR norm, a genuine red flag for capital growth. An 839 sqft 3BR is a squeezed shoebox-3BR layout that limits the family-buyer pool, and the 990m MRT walk is unremarkable. West Coast/One-North rental support and freehold tenure keep it Neutral rather than Avoid, but appreciation prospects look subpar.
